t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Don't just alternate between k and s keys. Try to figure out which gnome combinations give the most points and ignore the ones which give 0 points. The points that each gnome combination provides seems to change between rounds. Not sure if this helps but hopefully it does.

vb_textbox.text: Don't just randomly alternate between the keys. At first I thought it was the colour of the gnome that changes the value and avoided the gnomes that gave 0, but then I changed my strategy to choosing either the gnome on the left and then switching to the gnome on the right if the points started to decrease. I would then switch back to the gnome on the left if the points for the gnome on the right would go down.
